newsitem.title: UK: London PGMs drive precious metals firmer by close.
newsitem.headline: London PGMs drive precious metals firmer by close.

text.p: GOLD - Closed at $344.80/$345.30 up $1.30. Lost ground following OTC option expiry firmed with PGMs near close.
PALLADIUM - Stretched to $196.00/$197.00 at close up $20.25 on fund buying after record AM fix.
PLATINUM - Also closed firmer up $4.60 at $401.10/$402.10.
SILVER - Three cents easier at $4.71/$4.73. Off floor.
